EquipmentTest
.weapon()
Rarity
Affix
.ring()
.`rarities hold 1 2 3 4 and 4 affixes with the spec cost multipliers`()
Test
.`the value bands of the rarities never overlap so a better rarity always rolls higher`()
.`click damage percent is allowed on every slot but the weapon`()
.`an affix value is the base times one plus a tenth per refine level rounded down`()
.`a weapon click damage grows by a tenth of its base per level with one decimal`()
.`a piece that is not a weapon has no click damage`()
.`the refine cost is the floor of 500 times 1_7 to the level times the rarity multiplier`()
.`a piece at the maximum level has no refine cost`()
.`the reroll cost applies from level 5`()
.`the sell price is 100 times the rarity index times one plus half a level rounded down`()
.`a weapon without base click damage or another slot with one is rejected`()
.`a repeated affix type or click damage percent on a weapon is rejected`()
.`more affixes than the rarity allows is rejected`()
.`a refine level outside 0 to 10 is rejected`()
.`an affix base below one and a blank piece id are rejected`()
.`the rules reject a rate outside 0 to 1 a bag below one and a negative cost`()
.`refined raises the level by one and keeps everything else`()
.`refined rejects a piece at the maximum level`()
.`a reroll at level 5 replaces only the chosen affix with a type the piece lacked`()
.`a reroll rolls the new base inside the band of the piece rarity`()
.`a reroll on a weapon never lands on click damage percent`()
.`a reroll on another slot may land on click damage percent`()
.`a reroll below level 5 is rejected and changes nothing`()
.`a reroll of an affix the piece does not have is rejected`()
